headline_marked: Iran claims [[three US F-35 jets destroyed]] in Jordan strike
headline: Iran claims three US F-35 jets destroyed in Jordan strike
summary: The Middle East faces escalating conflict as Iran launches retaliatory attacks on US bases in Kuwait and Jordan following US strikes in Iran.
details: The Middle East is seeing a surge in conflict as the US and Iran engage in retaliatory strikes. Following a five-day lull, the US launched attacks on Iran on Wednesday night, resulting in casualties.

In response, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targeted US military bases in Kuwait and Jordan. The IRGC claims to have destroyed three US F-35 fighter jets and damaged three others at the Al-Azraq airbase in Jordan.

The US military has rejected Iran's claim regarding the destruction of the F-35 jets. Meanwhile, Kuwait reported that an Iranian attack on the Ali Al-Salem base damaged a civilian building, killing one worker.

The escalation comes despite recent diplomatic efforts and statements from US President Donald Trump that discussions were progressing well. Trump had warned Iran that they would face 'hard punishment' before the US strikes.
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has expressed deep concern, stating that the conflict is expanding and that a return to dialogue is urgently needed to prevent further escalation.
The regional tension is further complicated by ongoing Israeli strikes in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria, as well as Saudi Arabia's joint attack with the US in Iraq against Houthi targets.
US Central Command has deployed over 50,000 troops to the region as a precaution and to prepare for further potential operations.
caption:

The escalation comes despite recent diplomatic efforts and statements from US President Donald Trump that discussions were progressing well. Trump had warned Iran that they would face 'hard punishment' before the US strikes.

headline_marked: Dhaka residents face [[severe gas shortages]] as CPB protests
headline: Dhaka residents face severe gas shortages as CPB protests
summary: The Communist Party of Bangladesh (CPB) has held protests demanding an immediate solution to the ongoing gas crisis affecting various areas of the capital.
details: Various areas of Dhaka have been experiencing a severe gas crisis for several days, disrupting daily lives and cooking for residents.
The Communist Party of Bangladesh (CPB) has organized protests to demand a quick resolution to the energy shortage.
The CPB has specifically called for the authorities to stop collecting gas bills until the crisis is resolved.
The protests highlight the growing frustration among city dwellers who are struggling to maintain basic household needs due to the lack of of gas supply.
caption:
Dhaka is living by the 'gas clock' as severe shortages hit the capital.

Various areas of Dhaka have been experiencing a severe gas crisis for several days, disrupting daily lives and cooking for residents.

The Communist Party of Bangladesh (CPB) has organized protests to demand a quick resolution to the energy shortage.

The CPB has specifically called for the authorities to stop collecting gas bills until the crisis is resolved.

The protests highlight the growing frustration among city dwellers who are struggling to maintain basic household needs due to the lack of of gas supply.
